aub_upgrade_chain_tribe_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = tribe_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_tribe_02_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_1_cost }
			scope:aub_payer = { prestige >= expensive_building_tier_3_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = tribe_01
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = tribe_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_prestige_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_1_cost PRESTIGE = expensive_building_tier_3_cost }
		}
	}
}
